name: Auto Vehicle Parts LLC
about:
Auto Vehicle Parts LLC, operating as Auveco, is based in Cold Spring, Kentucky. The company traces its roots back more than a century, though an exact founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not specified in available sources.

Auveco manufactures and distributes a broad line of specialty automotive and industrial fasteners, including clips, body hardware, and related components. The company introduces new products monthly and supplies items in unit boxes, bulk quantities, and its proprietary AuvecoPaks—small bag packages for retail displays—as well as assortments and merchandising aids. Specific facility size, employee count, and annual volume figures are not disclosed.

The company serves the automotive and industrial sectors, supplying repair shops, retailers, and distributors with fasteners and body hardware. Its technical support team assists with product identification, availability, pricing, and delivery questions.

Auveco emphasizes four core values: starting and ending with the customer, acting with urgency (including same-day shipping on stocked items), transparency in products and processes, and continuous improvement driven by customer feedback. The company states its goal has remained the same for a century: complete customer satisfaction.
